title: Bankadelic podcast: SLMs, edge computing and biometrics = banking's tech muscle
summary: In this podcast published by Bankadelic here Sean Mallean, Head of Global Innovation at NCR Atleos, makes a strong case for how edge computing, small language models and biometrics can produce better banking results for financial institutions.
body_markdown: In this podcast published by Bankadelic[here](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/episode-232-slms-edge-computing-and-biometrics/id1503619691?i=1000771247352) Sean Mallean, Head of Global Innovation at NCR Atleos, makes a strong case for how edge computing, small language models and biometrics can produce better banking results for financial institutions.
